containerDefinitions.name: run-cycle
command: import asyncio; from price_watchdog.coordinator.coordinator import PriceMonitoringCoordinator; from price_watchdog.queue.publisher import SQSPublisher; from price_watchdog.coordinator.cycle_consolidator import CycleConsolidator; from price_watchdog.storage.price_store import PriceStore; from price_watchdog.reports.excel_report import ExcelReportGenerator; from price_watchdog.alerts.email_notifier import EmailNotifier; from price_watchdog.registry.competitor_manager import CompetitorManager; async def run(): pub=SQSPublisher(); ps=PriceStore(); rg=ExcelReportGenerator(); en=EmailNotifier(); cm=CompetitorManager(); cons=CycleConsolidator(price_store=ps,report_generator=rg,email_notifier=en); coord=PriceMonitoringCoordinator(publisher=pub,consolidator=cons,price_store=ps,competitor_manager=cm); cycle=await coord.run_cycle(); print(f'Cycle created: {cycle.id} status={cycle.status} total={cycle.total_products}'); asyncio.run(run())
